WarPointsRewardDefinition.Name: BattleWon
WarPointsRewardDefinition.Formula: Property(EncounterGroup, @ClassGroup, VictoryLevel) * ( Clamp01(Property(EncounterGroup, @ClassGroup, DestroyedCP)) + Clamp01(Property(EncounterGroup, @ClassGroup, EnemyHeroesKilledCount)) - Clamp01(Property(EncounterGroup, @ClassGroup, LostCP)))

WarPointsRewardDefinition.Name: BattleLost
WarPointsRewardDefinition.Formula: Property(EnemyEncounterGroup, @ClassGroup, VictoryLevel) * ( Clamp01(Property(EnemyEncounterGroup, @ClassGroup, DestroyedCP)) + Clamp01(Property(EnemyEncounterGroup, @ClassGroup, EnemyHeroesKilledCount)) - Clamp01(Property(EnemyEncounterGroup, @ClassGroup, LostCP))) * -0.1
